name: motir
description: Motir's skills for your coding agent: run the next card end to end, repair a card's red pull requests on their own branches, log a verified bug, clear the Bugs folder one pull request per bug, close a manual card, and be guided through a human card step by step. Installing it also connects the Motir MCP server, which you sign into in the browser the first time it is used, and carries a runner for the pinned `motir` CLI.
